what: Cross-check findings that have been read and are NOT misattributions. `python -m eval.litreview --untriaged` reports only findings absent from this list.
why: An earlier round read all 25 findings, concluded none was a misattribution, and recorded that in prose. The count drifted to 35 as the documents grew and nothing could tell a new finding from a cleared one. A reason recorded per finding makes the reading permanent.
how_to_add: Read the document at the finding, establish that a reader cannot misattribute the figure to the cited paper, and add an entry with a reason saying why. Never add an entry to silence a finding you have not read.

cleared.reason: Explicitly marked derived at the point of use - '(derived, see note)' - with the note below showing the arithmetic from the paper's own 55.7% accuracy and 71/140 per-class counts. Exemplary rather than defective.
